name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
summary: In Sludge Fen, Wizzlecrank's Shredder sits trapped among Venture Company operators. Pilot Wizzlecrank climbed inside the machine to steal it, but it will not move without a key. Its engine must be started before the goblin can try to escape.

sections.title: Trapped in the Sludge
sections.body: Deep in Sludge Fen, Wizzlecrank waits inside a motionless shredder. The Venture Company machine is surrounded by hostile mercenaries in the polluted basin. Wizzlecrank climbed aboard to steal it, then learned he needed a key to unlock its movement column. When another shredder operator asked if all was well, he panicked and blamed a mechanical problem. Now he remains sealed inside, with guards and overseers nearby, hoping someone will fetch the key before the Venture Company grows suspicious.

sections.title: A Clattering Breakout
sections.body: With the ignition key from the supervisor in the control room atop the derrick, the shredder clatters back to life. Pilot Wizzlecrank drives the lumbering machine through the mercenaries around him, its blades whirling and metal plating taking the blows. Passersby who sympathize with the trapped pilot escort the vulnerable contraption out of the basin and toward safety.

faq.answer: Pilot Wizzlecrank, a goblin, is inside the mechanical walker. He climbed into the Venture Company machine to steal it, then found himself trapped in their territory without its key.

faq.q: Why is the shredder stranded at Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: Wizzlecrank climbed into the shredder without knowing it needed a key to unlock its movement column. Surrounded by Venture Company laborers, drillers, and guards, he told a suspicious operator the machine had a mechanical problem. Now he waits inside for someone to fetch the key from the supervisor atop the derrick.

faq.q: Why is the shredder sometimes missing?
faq.answer: When the shredder is missing from Sludge Fen's northern depression, another traveler has started the ignition and is escorting Wizzlecrank to safety. It returns to its starting place shortly after the escort ends.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company doing at Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is exploiting the northern Barrens for crude oil, tar, and timber. Its work has turned a natural water source into a toxic, oily quagmire crowded with hired goons and foremen.

angles.text: The goblin shredder uses crude steam and piston technology. Pilot Wizzlecrank's predicament shows how easily a proprietary ignition system can fail in the field.
The Horde usually despises the Venture Company's deforestation and toxic exploitation of the Barrens. Helping a stranded pilot gives you a chance to smash up their drilling operations.
